verdicts.reason: A inverts the hierarchy: the headline 'Order online' is shrunk to a small label while 'food & drinks' becomes the largest text and runs over the takeout box image. The two rules float apart from the type, so the lockup is broken. B keeps the headline/subhead lockup intact and readable, but the bottom rule is gone and the top rule has been flung onto the cup and box photo as a stray line, which is an unwanted collision. Its text block also sits off-centre in the left panel.
